technique_name: What is the purpose of the International Space Station?
description: The International Space Station (ISS) is a modular space station orbiting Earth, operated by a partnership of five space agencies (NASA, Roscosmos, JAXA, ESA, and CSA). It is a unique platform for many scientific and technological research experiments, as well as manufacturing, exploration, and educational activities.
